case_number: 2024 INSC 755; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 2623-2631 OF 2014; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 2632-2640 OF 2014

parties.respondent: The State of Bihar and Others

summary: Assassination of MLA Brij Bihari Prasad at Patna hospital; prosecution vs High Court acquittal; reliability of eyewitnesses challenged - Paras Nath Chaudhury (family relationship, contradictions), Mahanth Ashwani Das (criminal record, witness protection), Shashi Bhushan Singh (delayed inclusion); FIR ante-dating; security personnel's retaliatory firing indicated by evidence; prosecution failed to prove charges beyond reasonable doubt; standard: proof beyond reasonable doubt not preponderance; appeal allowed restoring conviction.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.302, s.307, s.333, s.355, s.379, s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court acquittal set aside; original conviction and sentence restored.
